Name                     : DenyAllOutbound
Description              : Deny all outbound traffic
Protocol                 : *
SourcePortRange          : *
DestinationPortRange     : *
SourceAddressPrefix      : *
DestinationAddressPrefix : *
Access                   : Deny

registryEntry.label: Add NSG Rule — Deny All Outbound
registryEntry.get_command: Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nsg-workload-cmmc' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty SecurityRules | Where-Object Name -eq 'DenyAllOutbound' | Select-Object -First 1 Name,Access,Direction,Priority,SourceAddressPrefix,DestinationPortRange | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
registryEntry.set_command: $nsg = Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nsg-workload-cmmc'; Add-AzNetworkSecurityRuleConfig -NetworkSecurityGroup $nsg -Name 'DenyAllOutbound' -Description 'Deny all outbound traffic' -Protocol '*' -SourcePortRange '*' -DestinationPortRange '*' -SourceAddressPrefix '*' -DestinationAddressPrefix '*' -Access 'Deny' -Priority 4096 -Direction 'Outbound' | Set-AzNetworkSecurityGroup

metadata.commandExecuted: $nsg = Get-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -ResourceGroupName '{resourceGroup}' -Name 'nsg-workload-cmmc'; Add-AzNetworkSecurityRuleConfig -NetworkSecurityGroup $nsg -Name 'DenyAllOutbound' -Description 'Deny all outbound traffic' -Protocol '*' -SourcePortRange '*' -DestinationPortRange '*' -SourceAddressPrefix '*' -DestinationAddressPrefix '*' -Access 'Deny' -Priority 4096 -Direction 'Outbound' | Set-AzNetworkSecurityGroup
